title: Text 3
subtitle: 多元化配额与性别平等之争

sentences.en: Progressives often support diversity mandates as a path to equality and a way to level the playing field.
sentences.zh: 进步人士常常支持多元化强制要求，认为这是通往平等的路径，也是创造公平竞争环境的方式。

sentences.en: But all too often such policies are an insincere form of virtue-signaling that benefits only the most privileged and does little to help average people.
sentences.zh: 但这些政策往往只是一种虚伪的道德作秀，只惠及最有权势的精英，对普通人帮助甚微。

sentences.en: A pair of bills sponsored by Massachusetts state Senator Jason Lewis and House Speaker Pro Tempore Patricia Haddad, to ensure “gender parity” on boards and commissions, provide a case in point.
sentences.zh: 马萨诸塞州参议员杰森·刘易斯和众议院临时议长帕特里夏·哈达德联名提出的两项法案，旨在确保董事会和委员会的“性别平等”，就是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female.
sentences.zh: 哈达德和刘易斯担心，该州一半以上的政府委员会中女性占比不足40%。

sentences.en: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
sentences.zh: 为了确保精英女性有更多这样的机会，他们提议实行政府配额制。

sentences.en: If the bills become law, state boards and commissions will be required to set aside 50 percent of board seats for women by 2022.
sentences.zh: 如果这两项法案成为法律，到2022年，州政府及委员会将被要求为女性留出50%的席位。

sentences.en: The bills are similar to a measure recently adopted in California, which last year became the first state to require gender quotas for private companies.
sentences.zh: 这两项法案与加利福尼亚州最近通过的一项措施类似，加州去年成为第一个要求私营企业实行性别配额的州。

sentences.en: In signing the measure, California’s Governor Jerry Brown admitted that the law, which expressly classifies people on the basis of sex, is probably unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 加州州长杰里·布朗在签署该措施时承认，这部明确按性别对人群进行分类的法律很可能是违宪的。

sentences.en: The US Supreme Court frowns on sex-based classifications unless they are designed to address an “important” policy interest.
sentences.zh: 美国最高法院不赞成基于性别的分类，除非这些分类旨在解决“重要”的政策利益问题。

sentences.en: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of “equal protection”.
sentences.zh: 由于加州这部法律适用于所有董事会，即使在没有先前歧视历史的地方也是如此，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法所保障的“平等保护”。

sentences.en: But are such government mandates even necessary?
sentences.zh: 但这样的政府强制措施真的有必要吗？

sentences.en: Female participation on corporate boards may not currently mirror the percentage of women in the general population, but so what?
sentences.zh: 目前，女性在企业董事会的参与比例可能并没有反映女性在总人口中所占的百分比，但那又怎样呢？

sentences.en: The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government interference.
sentences.zh: 在没有政府干预的情况下，企业董事会中的女性人数一直在稳步增加。

sentences.en: According to a study by Catalyst, between 2010 and 2015 the share of women on the boards of global corporations increased by 54 percent.
sentences.zh: 根据Catalyst（卡特利斯特）的一项研究，2010年至2015年间，全球企业董事会中女性的比例增长了54%。

sentences.en: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
sentences.zh: 要求企业将性别作为进入董事会的首要资格，将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会经验不足。

sentences.en: That is exactly what happened when Norway adopted a nationwide corporate gender quota.
sentences.zh: 挪威在全国范围内实行企业性别配额制时，情况正是如此。

sentences.en: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a “golden skirt” phenomenon, where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
sentences.zh: 爱丽丝·李在《新共和》杂志撰文指出，在合格女性人才储备没有增加的情况下增加董事会成员的任职机会，导致了“黄金裙”现象，即同一批精英女性在各种董事会中一人身兼多职。

sentences.en: Next time somebody pushes corporate quotas as a way to promote gender equity, remember that such policies are largely self-serving measures that make their sponsors feel good but do little to help average women.
sentences.zh: 下次若有人把企业配额作为促进性别平等的途径加以推行，请记住，这类政策在很大程度上是利己之举，它们让提出者自我感觉良好，却对普通女性帮助甚微。

questions.stem: The author believes that the bills sponsored by Lewis and Haddad will ____

options.A: help little to reduce gender bias.
options.B: pose a threat to the state government.

questions.analysis: 纵观全文，文章一直在论述该法案，在最后一段作者提出了自己的想法，下次有人把企业配额作为促进性别平等的一种方式。请记住，这些基本上都是自私自利的措施，让他们的赞助商感觉良好，但其实并没有什么帮助，由此可见作者对此法案采取否定态度，A help little to reduce gender bias对减少性别偏见没什么帮助为同义替换的正确选项

questions.stem: Which of the following is true of the California measure?

options.A: It has irritated private business owners.
options.B: It is welcomed by the Supreme Court.
options.C: It may go against the Constitution.
options.D: It will settle the prior controversies.

questions.analysis: 根据题干中的关键词 California measures定位到原文第五段第二句，Because the California law applies to all boards, ... courts are likely to rule that the law violate the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection" violate 违反宪法，选项C against替换violate为正确选项

questions.stem: The author mentions the study by Catalyst to illustrate ____

options.A: the harm from arbitrary board decisions.
options.C: the pressure on women in global corporations.

questions.analysis: 根据题干中catalyst替换到第7段，论点为上一句The number of women on corporate boards has been steadily increasing without government . 在没有政府的情况下，公司董事会中的妇女人数一直在稳步增加。可见D选项中the needlessness of government interventions政府干预的不必要性

questions.stem: Norway’s adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota has led to ____

options.A: the underestimation of elite women’s role.
options.B: the objection to female participation on boards.
options.C: the entry of unqualified candidates into the board.
options.D: the growing tension between labor and management.

questions.analysis: 根据Norway定位到倒数第三段第一句，要求将性别作为董事会成员的主要资格，必然会导致私营部门董事会减少。紧接着下文董事会成员的机会越来越多，却没有合格的女性来担任董事会成员， 由此可见会有不合格的人进入董事会，正确选项C 不合格候选人进入董事会

questions.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from the text?

options.A: Women’s needs in employment should be considered.
options.B: Feasibility should be a prime concern in policymaking.
options.C: Everyone should try hard to promote social justice.
options.D: Major social issues should be the focus of legislation.
